text: “I believe in Karma. If the good is sown, the good is collected. When positive things are made, that returns well.” – Yannick Noah As we reviewed yesterday , the moves discussed in the latest Weekly Outlook Video are in play. Short-term, the focus will be to see if the bears can hold the pressure on as we move through triple witching. Clearly, the risk is of a bounce into expiration and how markets move will be very telling. The biggest surprise to most participants will be if indices continue to hold heavy into the close on Friday.
